# frozen_string_literal: true
require File.expand_path("config/application", Dir.pwd)
Rails.application.config.yjit = false
require File.expand_path("config/environment", Dir.pwd)
require "rack/mock"
require "json"
require "digest"
Rails.application.eager_load!
Rails.logger.level = :warn
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = nil
raise "Lowrail loaded" if defined?(Lowrail)
session = Rack::MockRequest.new(Rails.application)
headers = { "HTTP_HOST" => "localhost", "HTTPS" => "on" }
all = {}
summary = {}
{ "show" => "/articles/1", "index" => "/articles" }.each do |label, path|
  request = -> { r = session.get(path, headers); raise r.status.to_s unless r.status == 200 }
  50.times { request.call }
  records = { tags: [], attributes: [], blanks: [] }
  callers = Hash.new(0)
  classes = Hash.new(0)
  index = 0
  trace = TracePoint.new(:call) do |tp|
    if tp.defined_class == ActionView::Helpers::TagHelper::TagBuilder
      args = case tp.method_id
      when :tag_options then [:tags, [tp.binding.local_variable_get(:options), tp.binding.local_variable_get(:escape)]]
      when :tag_option then [:attributes, [:key, :value, :escape].map { tp.binding.local_variable_get(_1) }]
      end
      records[args[0]] << Marshal.load(Marshal.dump(args[1])) if args && index.zero?
    elsif tp.defined_class == String && tp.method_id == :blank?
      locations = caller_locations(1, 20).reject { _1.path == __FILE__ || _1.path == tp.path }
      callers[locations.first.to_s] += 1
      value = tp.self
      classes[value.class.name] += 1
      records[:blanks] << value.dup if index.zero?
    end
  end
  trace.enable { 10.times { |i| index = i; request.call } }
  all[label] = records
  summary[label] = { calls_per_request: records.transform_values(&:size), blank_callers_per_request: callers.transform_values { _1 / 10.0 },
    blank_classes_per_request: classes.transform_values { _1 / 10.0 },
    blank_inputs: records[:blanks].group_by { |s| [s.encoding.name, s.empty?, s.ascii_only?, s.empty? ? nil : s.getbyte(0) > 32] }.transform_keys(&:inspect).transform_values(&:size),
    tag_shapes: records[:tags].map { |opts, escape| { escape: escape, keys: opts&.keys&.map(&:to_s), value_classes: opts&.values&.map { _1.class.name } } } }
end
File.binwrite("/tmp/next-levers/blog-inputs.marshal", Marshal.dump(all))
File.chmod(0o600, "/tmp/next-levers/blog-inputs.marshal")
File.write("/tmp/next-levers/census.json", JSON.pretty_generate(summary))
puts JSON.pretty_generate(summary)

# frozen_string_literal: true
require "/home/user/workspace/repo/bench/pass"
root = "/home/user/workspace/repo"
app = File.join(root, ".corpus/react-starter-kit")
out, jit, format = ARGV
raise "new output required" if File.exist?(out)
FileUtils.mkdir_p(out, mode: 0o700)
ENV["BENCH_JIT"] = jit
headers = File.read(File.join(app, "tmp/m0/headers-#{format}.json"))
base = { "RAILS_ENV" => "production", "SECRET_KEY_BASE_DUMMY" => "1", "RAILS_LOG_LEVEL" => "error",
  "BENCH_JIT" => jit, "BENCH_HEADERS" => headers, "LOWRAIL" => "0", "RUBYOPT" => nil,
  "LOWRAIL_STATS" => nil, "LOWRAIL_DEBUG" => nil, "LOWRAIL_UNITS" => nil }
roots = %w[default config].to_h { [_1, "/tmp/next-levers/#{jit}-#{_1}"] }
environments = %w[off_a off_b].to_h { [_1, base] }
roots.each do |arm, build_root|
  environments[arm] = base.merge("LOWRAIL" => "1", "LOWRAIL_ROOT" => build_root,
    "RUBYOPT" => "-I#{root}/gem/lib -rlowrail/setup")

coverage = roots.to_h do |arm, build_root|
  ids = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(build_root, ".lowrail/manifest.json"))).fetch("units").map { _1.fetch("id") }.join(",")
  [arm, PassBench.probe(app, out, environments.fetch(arm).merge("BENCH_UNITS" => ids, "LOWRAIL_STATS" => ""),

fingerprints = roots.to_h { |arm, path| [arm, PassBench.preflight(File.join(path, ".lowrail"), File.join(root, "gem/lib"))] }

  revision: `git -C #{root} rev-parse HEAD`.strip, runtime: PassBench.runtime_fingerprint(File.join(root, "gem/lib")),

raise "runtime drift" unless metadata[:runtime] == PassBench.runtime_fingerprint(File.join(root, "gem/lib"))

# frozen_string_literal: true
root = "/home/user/workspace/repo"
require "#{root}/bench/jit_stability"
require File.expand_path("config/application", Dir.pwd)
Rails.application.config.yjit = false unless JitStability.mode == "yjit"
require File.expand_path("config/environment", Dir.pwd)
require "json"
require "prism"
require "digest"
require "#{root}/bench/heap_windows"
require ENV.fetch("BENCH_CALLGRIND_EXTENSION")
Rails.application.eager_load!
Rails.logger.level = :warn
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = nil
JitStability.assert_mode!
raise "Lowrail loaded" if defined?(Lowrail)

class Definitions < Prism::Visitor
  attr_reader :methods
  def initialize = @methods = {}
  def visit_def_node(node) = @methods[node.name] = node.location.slice
end
def definitions(path)
  parser = Definitions.new
  parser.visit(Prism.parse_file(path).value)
  parser.methods
end
def string_blank(path)
  tree = Prism.parse_file(path).value
  node = tree.statements.body.find { _1.is_a?(Prism::ClassNode) && _1.constant_path.location.slice == "String" }
  node.body.body.find { _1.is_a?(Prism::DefNode) && _1.name == :blank? }.location.slice
end
tag_source = "/tmp/next-levers/upstream-tag.rb"
old_tag_source = ActionView::Helpers::TagHelper::TagBuilder.instance_method(:tag_options).source_location.first
ordinary = %i[tag_options tag_option prefix_tag_option boolean_tag_option]
{ "PricingOldTagBuilder" => [old_tag_source, ordinary],
  "PricingMainTagBuilder" => [tag_source, ordinary + %i[append_tag_option append_prefix_tag_option append_boolean_tag_option]] }.each do |name, (source, methods)|
  defs = definitions(source)
  ActionView::Helpers::TagHelper.module_eval(<<~RUBY, source, 1)
    # frozen_string_literal: true
    class #{name} < TagBuilder
      #{methods.map { defs.fetch(_1) }.join("\n")}
      private :tag_option, :prefix_tag_option, :boolean_tag_option
    end
  RUBY
end
controller = ArticlesController.new
request = ActionDispatch::TestRequest.create
controller.set_request!(request)
controller.set_response!(ArticlesController.make_response!(request))
view = controller.view_context
real_tag = ActionView::Helpers::TagHelper::TagBuilder.new(view)
old_tag = ActionView::Helpers::TagHelper::PricingOldTagBuilder.new(view)
new_tag = ActionView::Helpers::TagHelper::PricingMainTagBuilder.new(view)
blank_source = "/tmp/next-levers/upstream-blank.rb"
old_blank_source = String.instance_method(:blank?).source_location.first
old_blank_class, new_blank_class = [old_blank_source, blank_source].map do |path|
  klass = Class.new(String)
  klass.class_eval("# frozen_string_literal: true\n#{string_blank(path)}", path, 1)
  klass
end
signature = ->(value) { [value.class.name, value.to_s.bytes, value.respond_to?(:encoding) ? value.encoding.name : nil, value.frozen?, value.respond_to?(:html_safe?) && value.html_safe?] }
outcome = ->(&operation) { operation.call rescue [$!.class.name, $!.message] }
inputs = Marshal.load(File.binread("/tmp/next-levers/blog-inputs.marshal"))
operations = {}
counts = {}
equivalence = {}
arm = ENV.fetch("PRICE_ARM", "off") == "on" ? :on : :off
def object_price(operation)
  10.times { operation.call }
  GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects)
  before = GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects)
  1000.times { operation.call }
  (GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects) - before) / 1000.0
end
object_price(-> {}) # Warm the exact observer/loop endpoints before comparing.
inputs.each do |route, rows|
  rows[:tags].each do |opts, escape|
    real = signature.call(real_tag.tag_options(opts, escape))
    raise "tag output mismatch" unless real == signature.call(old_tag.tag_options(opts, escape)) && real == signature.call(new_tag.tag_options(opts, escape))
  end
  rows[:attributes].each do |key, value, escape|
    real = signature.call(real_tag.send(:tag_option, key, value, escape))
    raise "attribute mismatch" unless real == signature.call(old_tag.send(:tag_option, key, value, escape)) && real == signature.call(new_tag.send(:tag_option, key, value, escape))
  end
  old_values, new_values = [old_blank_class, new_blank_class].map { |klass| rows[:blanks].map { klass.new(_1) } }
  rows[:blanks].zip(old_values, new_values).each { |a, b, c| raise "blank mismatch" unless a.blank? == b.blank? && a.blank? == c.blank? }
  real_ops = {
    "tag_options" => -> { rows[:tags].each { |opts, escape| real_tag.tag_options(opts, escape) } },
    "tag_option" => -> { rows[:attributes].each { |key, value, escape| real_tag.send(:tag_option, key, value, escape) } },
    "blank" => -> { rows[:blanks].each(&:blank?) }
  }
  old_ops = {
    "tag_options" => -> { rows[:tags].each { |opts, escape| old_tag.tag_options(opts, escape) } },
    "tag_option" => -> { rows[:attributes].each { |key, value, escape| old_tag.send(:tag_option, key, value, escape) } },
    "blank" => -> { old_values.each(&:blank?) }
  }
  real_ops.each do |name, operation|
    a, b = object_price(operation), object_price(old_ops.fetch(name))
    raise "unchanged specimen allocation mismatch #{route}/#{name}: #{a} != #{b}" unless a == b
    equivalence["#{route}/#{name}"] = { real: a, unchanged_specimen: b }
  end
  builder = arm == :on ? new_tag : old_tag
  values = arm == :on ? new_values : old_values
  operations["#{route}/tag_options"] = -> { rows[:tags].each { |opts, escape| builder.tag_options(opts, escape) } }
  operations["#{route}/tag_option"] = -> { rows[:attributes].each { |key, value, escape| builder.send(:tag_option, key, value, escape) } }
  operations["#{route}/blank"] = -> { values.each(&:blank?) }
  %w[tag_options tag_option blank].zip(%i[tags attributes blanks]).each { |name, key| counts["#{route}/#{name}"] = rows[key].size }
end
blank_checks = 0
Encoding.list.reject(&:dummy?).each do |encoding|
  samples = (0..255).map { [_1].pack("C").force_encoding(encoding) }
  samples += ["", " \t\n\r\v\f", "  x", "\u00a0", "\u3000", "雪", "\0"].filter_map { _1.encode(encoding) rescue nil }
  samples.each do |value|
    a = outcome.call { value.blank? }
    b = outcome.call { new_blank_class.new(value).blank? }
    raise "blank boundary mismatch #{encoding}: #{value.bytes}" unless a == b
    blank_checks += 1
  end
end
if ENV["PRICE_CHECK_ONLY"]
  puts JSON.pretty_generate(equivalence: equivalence, blank_checks: blank_checks)
  exit
end
def repeat(count, operation) = count.times { operation.call }
operations.each_value { repeat(50, _1) }
jit_warmup = JitStability.warm { |n| operations.each_value { repeat(n, _1) } } if JitStability.enabled?
n = Integer(ENV.fetch("BENCH_REQUESTS", "1000"))
windows = HeapWindows.windows(n, operations.keys)
anchors = HeapWindows.run(windows, observe: JitStability.enabled? ? JitStability.method(:snapshot) : nil) do |count, unit|
  repeat(count, operations.fetch(unit))
end
puts "LOWRAIL_BENCH #{JSON.generate(**JitStability.state, ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION, windows: windows,
  heap_anchors: anchors, jit_warmup: jit_warmup, blank_checks: blank_checks, equivalence: equivalence,
  operations: counts.transform_values { { invocations_per_iteration: _1 } },
  sources: [__FILE__, tag_source, blank_source, old_blank_source, old_tag_source].to_h { [_1, Digest::SHA256.file(_1).hexdigest] })}"

    [metric, RequestPairs.estimate(rows.map { _1.fetch("off_a").fetch(metric) - _1.fetch("on").fetch(metric) }, seed: 41231)]
  end
  [unit, summary]
end
accepted &&= budgets.values.all? { _1[:aa][:pass] }
